# yFiles for HTML developer documentation

## Overview

yFiles for HTML 3.1 is a commercial browser diagramming SDK. Official documentation
describes graph editing, interaction, keyboard and touch input, undo/redo, persistence,
SVG/WebGL styles, graph analysis, filtering, and multiple automatic and incremental layout
families. Threat semantics and human review remain application behavior.

## Evidence used by RPT-0006

- Developer guide: https://docs.yworks.com/yfiles-html/dguide/
- Automatic layouts: https://docs.yworks.com/yfiles-html/dguide/automatic-layouts-main-chapter/index.html
- Licensing: https://docs.yworks.com/yfiles-html/dguide/deployment/licensing.html
- Release announcement: https://www.yworks.com/news
- Public graph-editor demo: https://www.yfiles.com/demos/view/grapheditor/index.html
- Evaluation access: https://my.yworks.com/signup?product=YFILES_HTML_EVAL
- Evaluation setup: https://docs.yworks.com/yfiles-html/dguide/getting_started-ide/

## Applicability

Primary documentation for the commercial SDK option in Issue #10. It bears on no accepted
decision in this record.

## Limits

The evaluation package and license require customer-center access. RPT-0006 did not run
the common fixture with yFiles, so the assessment remains documentation-only. Pricing and
redistribution implications need scenario-specific review.
